title: Working partner - employment recruitment company
description:
**Title:** Working Partner – Employment Recruitment Business (Kochi)

**Location:** Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala

**Job type:** Partnership / Full-time

**About the opportunity**

I have a fully furnished legally registered (MSME+GST) office premise in Kaloor, Kochi, ready for immediate use, with electricity, water, air conditioning and a high-speed internet connection in place. I am looking for a working partner (male / female) to set up and run an employment recruitment / staffing consultancy from this office.

The partner will actively manage the day-to-day business and share in its profits.

**What you will do**

* Build and run the recruitment operation end to end: sourcing candidates, client acquisition, screening, placements
* Develop relationships with employers in Kochi and across Kerala / india
* Manage a small team as the business grows
* Handle compliance, documentation and client agreements

**What I’m looking for**

* [2–5]+ years in recruitment, HR, staffing or placement consultancy
* Existing network of clients or candidates is a strong advantage
* Fluent in Malayalam and English a plus
* Entrepreneurial, self-driven, comfortable with a profit-share model
* Based in or willing to relocate to Kochi

**What’s on offer**

* Rent-free, fully equipped office with all utilities and internet
* [Profit-sharing / profit share, terms negotiable”]
* [no investment is required from you]

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note on your recruitment experience and how you’d approach building the business

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

title: HR & Workforce Operations Executive
description:
**Company:** Taskmario  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Experience:** 2–4 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About the Role

Taskmario is looking for a proactive and organised HR & Workforce Operations Executive to manage internal HR activities, house-helper recruitment and welfare, service quality, and office administration.

The goal is to build a reliable team, establish clear processes, and reduce the founder's involvement in day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Maid Recruitment & Onboarding**

* Conduct telephonic and face-to-face interviews.
* Maintain helper profiles, documents, skills, availability, and work status.
* Coordinate onboarding, ID cards, T-shirts, and training.
* Work with the existing recruitment team to meet workforce requirements.

**2. Helper Welfare & Quality**

* Maintain regular communication with helpers and address their concerns.
* Collect client feedback regularly and track complaints.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, conduct, and service quality.
* Conduct training and ensure helpers follow Taskmario's standards.
* Support helper retention, safety, and professional development.

**3. Internal HR & Staff Performance**

* Maintain employee records, attendance, and leave.
* Create and update Job Descriptions (JDs) and KPIs for all staff.
* Track sales team productivity and follow up on performance gaps.
* Conduct interviews and onboard new employees when required.

**4. Administration & Coordination**

* Manage routine office administration and internal coordination.
* Maintain organised Google Sheets, records, and reports.
* Coordinate recruitment, sales, and customer-relations activities.
* Develop SOPs, checklists, and workflows to improve accountability.
* Build repeatable HR and workforce systems to support expansion into new cities.

Requirements

* 1–2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, staffing, or operations.
* Strong Malayalam communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Docs, and WhatsApp.
* Good organisational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage tasks independently and handle confidential information.
* A proactive, responsible, and process-oriented mindset.

Key Performance Indicators

* Recruitment and onboarding progress.
* Accuracy of helper profiles and staff records.
* Regular client feedback and complaint resolution.
* Helper training, retention, and service quality.
* Internal staff productivity and reporting.
* Completion of JDs, SOPs, and administrative tasks.

Reporting & Authority

Reports directly to the Founder. Expected to handle routine decisions independently and escalate serious complaints, major HR decisions, and exceptional issues for approval.

**Expected outcome:** Build a reliable workforce, improve staff accountability, establish structured HR processes, and enable the founder to focus on business growth and expansion.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: HR Coordinator
description:
**Job Description: HR Coordinator**

**Company:** IBO INFOTECH  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Qualification:** BBA or MBA in Human Resources (mandatory)  
**Salary:** Upto 30,000 per month + Incentives + Allowances  
**Languages:** Malayalam,English, Hindi, Tamil, and Kannada

**Job Summary**

IBO INFOTECH is looking for an experienced HR Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities, build strong talent pipelines, and ensure timely hiring for various roles, especially in the IT sector. The ideal candidate should have strong recruitment expertise, knowledge of recruitment policies and best practices, and the ability to work effectively in a pure recruitment-focused environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle: requirement understanding, job posting, sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding.
* Use multiple sourcing channels such as job portals, social media, employee referrals, databases, and campus drives.
* Conduct initial screening and interviews; assess candidates for technical and cultural fit.
* Maintain and update candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and ATS/CRM tools.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill sets, and timelines.
* Ensure adherence to company recruitment policies, processes, and quality standards.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pool for current and future hiring needs.
* Prepare and share regular recruitment MIS reports (openings, closures, TAT, source effectiveness, etc.).
* Support HR in onboarding formalities, documentation, and induction activities.
* Maintain a professional and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* BBA or MBA in Human Resources from a recognized institution (mandatory).
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on recruitment experience, with at least 2 years in the IT industry.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment policies, processes, and best practices; experience in a pure recruitment or staffing environment is highly preferred.
* Excellent sourcing, screening, and interviewing skills across entry, mid, and senior levels.
* Good understanding of IT roles, skills, and industry hiring trends.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Fluency in English, Hindi, Tamil, and Kannada (both spoken and written).
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and familiarity with job portals and ATS/CRM tools.
* Ability to handle high-volume hiring, multiple openings, and tight deadlines.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Requirements**

* Strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy, and data privacy.
* Good time management, follow-up, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with HR, hiring managers, and leadership.
* Willingness to learn new tools, techniques, and evolving recruitment practices.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.
* Candidates may be required to undergo an interview, practical recruitment assignment, and background verification.

**How to Apply**

Send your updated resume and copies of educational certificates to:

**Email:** iboinfotech.hr@gmail.com  
**Subject:** Application for HR Recruiter – [Candidate Name]

Work Location: In person
